method: Keyword counts are regular-expression matches over each loop's prompt, verification, steps, why and note; they are approximate and over/under-count. Pattern assignments were made by hand from reading each loop's title, verification line and the first ~260 characters of its prompt, not the full text of every loop. A loop can belong to several patterns. Source catalog: Forward Future Loop Library, fetched 2026-10-28, 85 loops.

keywordCounts.label: Changes one thing at a time
Keeps a change only if it helps
Uses an independent reviewer or critic
Tests from a clean or held-out state
Names a budget, pass limit or cap
Mentions approval, a question to the user, or handing back
Keeps a state file, ledger or log
Runs on a schedule or trigger
Names a program-run check (tests, build, scan, benchmark)

patterns.name: Ratchet
patterns.summary: Measure, change one thing, measure again with the same check, keep it only if it helped.

patterns.name: Inventory and ledger
patterns.summary: List every item in scope, then label each with its evidence status. Done when no item lacks a status.

patterns.name: Builder and independent reviewer
patterns.summary: One session or model makes the change; a separate one checks it, ideally from a different model family or a clean context.

patterns.name: Streak
patterns.summary: Success must repeat N times in a row; any failure resets the count.

patterns.name: Clean-room replay
patterns.summary: Start from a fresh clone, session or restored backup and follow only the documented steps.

patterns.name: Scheduled sweep
patterns.summary: A timer or event wakes the loop; with nothing to do, it stops without changes.

patterns.name: State file and handoff
patterns.summary: State lives in a file, so a new session can resume without guessing.

patterns.name: Approval gate
patterns.summary: The loop must ask before outside actions or when judgment is needed.

patterns.name: Loops about loops
patterns.summary: The loop examines, mines or hires other loops, or writes the plan for a long run.

patterns.name: Persist to an external finish
patterns.summary: Keep following up until the outside world reaches a terminal state, or a real blocker needs the person.
